system.description: Heal an adjacent allied unit by 2d6 + Cha HP and 1d4 Stn.
Heal an adjacent allied unit by 4d6 + Cha HP and 2d4 Stn.
A mundane, but nevertheless potent and reliable offensive spell for the common mage.

Hurl a flask of bottled flame at a target square. All units on that square and directly adjacent to that square are dealt 2d12 Fire damage and 2 Brk damage. On a successful Agi saving throw (DC 8 + caster Tqn), affected units only take 1d12 Fire damage and no Brk damage.

The tiles caught in the explosion are set aflame for 1 turn. These squares count as Difficult Terrain (2 Mov cost) and inflict 5 Fire Dmg to units who end their phase on them. They additionally emit 1 sq radius of light.
A condensed mote of radiant energy, formed when morning dew captures solar magic and crystallizes. Sometimes worn decoratively in jewelery, but has potent magical properties in the right hands.
Fine particles infused with residual magical energy. Used in enchanting, rituals, and spell components. Unstable in large quantities.
A mineral infused with natural magical power. Used to enhance equipment, fuel magical devices, or as a core crafting material for enchanted items.
